设置参数`editable=True`后，可配合参数`editConfig`进行.en-us: Set `editable=True` and use `editConfig` to configure image editing.

设置参数`confirmBeforeDelete=True`为已上传文件记录的删.en-us: Set `confirmBeforeDelete=True` to require confirmation before deleting an uploaded file.

设置参数`showPreviewIcon`、`showRemoveIcon`控制.en-us: Use `showPreviewIcon` and `showRemoveIcon` to control preview and delete icon visibility for uploaded images.
